description: This file contains common declarations, structures, macros, and function prototypes for dialog modules using ncurses, including UI element definitions, color settings, and dialog control functions.

classes.name: dialog_color
classes.description: Structure defining color attributes for dialog UI elements.

classes.name: subtitle_list
classes.description: Linked list structure for managing subtitles in dialogs.

classes.name: dialog_info
classes.description: Structure holding dialog window appearance and behavior settings.

classes.name: dialog_item
classes.description: Structure representing a menu or checklist item with prompt, tag, data, and selection status.

classes.name: dialog_list
classes.description: Linked list node for managing collections of dialog items.

methods.name: item_reset
methods.description: Resets the item list to an initial state.

methods.name: item_make
methods.description: Creates a new item with formatted prompt.

methods.name: item_add_str
methods.description: Adds a string prompt to the item list.

methods.name: item_set_tag
methods.description: Sets the tag character for the current item.

methods.name: item_set_data
methods.description: Associates data pointer with the current item.

methods.name: item_set_selected
methods.description: Marks the current item as selected or not.

methods.name: item_activate_selected
methods.description: Activates the selected item.

methods.name: item_data
methods.description: Retrieves data associated with the current item.

methods.name: item_tag
methods.description: Returns the tag character of the current item.

methods.name: item_count
methods.description: Returns the number of items.

methods.name: item_set
methods.description: Selects an item by index.

methods.name: item_n
methods.description: Returns the index of the current item.

methods.name: item_str
methods.description: Returns the prompt string of the current item.

methods.name: item_is_selected
methods.description: Checks if the current item is selected.

methods.name: item_is_tag
methods.description: Checks if the current item's tag matches the given character.

methods.name: on_key_esc
methods.description: Handles escape key press in a window.

methods.name: on_key_resize
methods.description: Handles terminal resize events.

methods.name: init_dialog
methods.description: Initializes dialog with a background title.

methods.name: set_dialog_backtitle
methods.description: Sets the background title for dialogs.

methods.name: set_dialog_subtitles
methods.description: Sets subtitles for dialogs.

methods.name: end_dialog
methods.description: Ends the dialog session and restores terminal.

methods.name: attr_clear
methods.description: Clears a window with specified attributes.

methods.name: dialog_clear
methods.description: Clears dialog contents.

methods.name: print_autowrap
methods.description: Prints text with automatic wrapping.

methods.name: print_button
methods.description: Displays a button with label at specified position.

methods.name: print_title
methods.description: Displays a title in the dialog window.

methods.name: draw_box
methods.description: Draws a box with borders in a window.

methods.name: draw_shadow
methods.description: Draws a shadow effect around a window.

methods.name: first_alpha
methods.description: Finds the first alphabetic character in a string, optionally exempting certain characters.

methods.name: dialog_yesno
methods.description: Displays a yes/no dialog box.

methods.name: dialog_msgbox
methods.description: Displays a message box.

methods.name: dialog_textbox
methods.description: Displays a text box with scroll and extra key handling.

methods.name: dialog_menu
methods.description: Displays a menu dialog.

methods.name: dialog_checklist
methods.description: Displays a checklist dialog.

methods.name: dialog_inputbox
methods.description: Displays an input box dialog.
